coverage: Two selected recommendations only. Not a complete mental health reference collection.

passages.text: Do not use a loading dose of antipsychotic medication (often referred to as 'rapid neuroleptisation').
passages.source_title: Psychosis and schizophrenia in adults: prevention and management
passages.scope_notes: Adults; recommendation in antipsychotic prescribing section. Does not establish broader treatment suitability.

passages.text: Do not use risk assessment tools and scales to predict future suicide or repetition of self-harm.
passages.source_title: Self-harm: assessment, management and preventing recurrence
passages.scope_notes: Specific to prediction of future events. Does not prohibit psychosocial assessment or risk formulation.
